dict.string: CoreAutism studies physiological signals recorded by Apple Watch during research activities.
CoreAutism collects Apple Watch optical pulse (PPG) measurements and their associated motion and quality information to study physiological changes during research activities.
CoreAutism uses motion measurements associated with the Apple Watch recording to describe recording quality.
CoreAutism uses wrist-worn state information to identify whether the Apple Watch was being worn during a recording.
CoreAutism may use ECG information associated with an approved recording to support physiological analysis.
CoreAutism may use heart-rate information associated with an approved recording to support physiological analysis.
